supplier_excerpts.excerpt:
If
$$\mathbb E[X_{k+1}\mid\mathcal F_k]\le(1+a_k)X_k-b_k+c_k\quad\text{almost surely for every }k,$$
then $X_k$ converges almost surely to a finite nonnegative random variable and $\sum_{k\ge0}b_k<\infty$ almost surely.

By [[lem-conditional-variance-is-well-defined-and-has-the-second-moment-formula]], it satisfies
$$\mathbb E[\|G_k\|_2^2\mid\mathcal F_k]=\|\mathbb E[G_k\mid\mathcal F_k]\|_2^2+\operatorname{Var}(G_k\mid\mathcal F_k)$$
almost surely.
